Implemented the `locate-character` v3 compatibility fix.

Rollup source no longer imports `locate-character`; it now uses a small internal `src/utils/locate.ts` helper with the existing “known offset must resolve” behavior. Internal call sites were switched to that helper, and generated license files were updated because `locate-character` is no longer bundled.

I also added a Mocha-only CommonJS compatibility hook so the unchanged test suite can still `require('locate-character')` even though v3 is ESM-only.

`npm run ci:test` passes against `locate-character@3.0.0`.
